messages:
Priya S: Heads-up: SilverHarbor private deploy Week2 smoke failing for audit delivery. Customer says S3 objects appear intermittently and our service cannot decrypt. They're nervous about the upcoming renewal. Need quick triage on networking/IAM/KMS.

Ethan L: On it. Ask them for `aws kms list-aliases --region us-east-1` and `aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket silverharbor-audit`. Also confirm if they created a cross-account RedwooodLogDelivery role.

Priya S: Posted sanitized outputs: no alias/silver-prod, alias/silver-staging exists; bucket policy allows PutObject from org but no explicit account. They confirm no delivery role in their account.

Miguel R: Likely cross-account role + KMS key policy issue. I'll draft a minimal grant flow for the KMS key and a trust policy snippet for the role.

ops-bot: Ticket CS-9002 created, priority=P1, reminder in 30m.

Devon C: Drafted role + policy snippet and a short runbook: (1) create RedwoodLogDelivery role with CloudTrail trust, (2) add KMS grant for our service principal, (3) enable staging prefix to validate. Pasting to ticket now.

Ethan L: If they can enable staging prefix and put objects there, we can validate decrypt once they apply the grant. If not, request an export to a shared prefix so we can ingest temporarily.

Priya S: Shared plan with customer. Sales alerted on renewal risk; legal looped for potential short-term credit if we miss BETA. No promises.

Miguel R: I'll join the working session if grant/decrypt fails. Schedule 15m sync with Sales+CS at 11:45 PT.

Priya S: Thanks team. Will update when customer posts grant result. :pray:
